label.name: Name

notice.failed: The approvals service did not answer. This is not an empty tenant.
notice.detailIsFirstRow: The detail below is the first row of the listing above, read once.
notice.identifiersNotNames: Members, subjects and records are shown by identifier. Resolving one to a person’s name belongs to another module and is not read here.
notice.actionsAreApi: This screen reads only. Raising, deciding, cancelling, publishing and retiring are operations of the approvals API, and the server decides each one.
notice.queueIsAmbient: “Waiting for you” is resolved from the signed-in request. This screen never asks for somebody else’s queue, and there is no field through which it could.
notice.approverIsConfigured: The approver on a step is the member configured to be asked. It is not the person reading this screen.
notice.commentOnDecision: A rejection comment stays on the decision, where a permission decides who may read it. It is never moved into the timeline.
notice.historyIsRouting: The timeline records routing only — who was asked, who answered, and when. A business outcome belongs to the module that owns the record.
notice.subjectIsOpaque: A subject type and a subject identifier are the owning module’s own values. Approvals stores them and interprets neither.

withheld.sla: No approval has a service level, a due time or an age. Nothing is measured against one.
withheld.businessDays: Nothing is calculated in business days. Approvals holds no calendar and no working-time rule.
withheld.escalation: Nothing escalates. There is no reassignment after a delay and no next approver on a timer.
withheld.scheduling: Nothing is scheduled. No approval is advanced, closed or reviewed by a background job.
withheld.approvalExpiry: No approval expires. `expired` is declared in the approval vocabulary and this phase never produces it.
withheld.delegationExpiry: A delegation is not expired automatically. Whether one is in force is answered when a decision is made.
withheld.parallelApproval: Every chain is sequential. There is no parallel branch and no simultaneous approver.
withheld.tally: There is no majority, unanimous, quorum or first-response rule. One named member answers each step.
withheld.conditionalBranching: There is no conditional routing. A chain does not branch on the value of the record it is about.
withheld.roles: There is no role directory. A step names a member, never a role.
withheld.groups: There is no group directory. A step names a member, never a group.
withheld.managerRouting: Managers are not resolved. Nothing here routes to somebody’s manager or reads a reporting line.
withheld.externalApprovers: There is no external approver. Everybody asked is a member of this tenant.
withheld.notificationDelivery: Nothing is delivered. No email, message or push notification is sent when somebody is asked to decide.
withheld.analytics: There are no approval analytics. No success rate, average time, bottleneck or compliance figure is calculated anywhere.
withheld.asynchronousCallbacks: There is no asynchronous callback. A decision reaches the module that raised the approval inside the approver’s own request.
withheld.outbox: There is no outbox and no message broker. Nothing is queued for later delivery.
